arguments.conclusion: The government will ultimately have to rely on quantitative easing to finance its debt, resulting in persistently high inflation, interest rates, and asset prices.

arguments.premise_synthesis: The Senate rejected an amendment to eliminate interest on reserves (vote 14–83), removing one potential source of Treasury demand. Other funding sources such as stablecoins or gimmicks are insufficient to meet large government borrowing needs. Therefore, quantitative easing remains the only sustainable solution for government debt.
arguments.conclusion_supported: The Federal Reserve will covertly or indirectly engage in quantitative easing to support government borrowing, expanding the money supply and preventing a debt crisis but causing inflation.

source_speech_filenames: 20251016_The Fed Just Announced When QT Will End.txt
